title: The pond population settles at 300
caption: From 200 fish, each year the population is 0.9 of last year's plus 30: P₁ = 210, P₂ = 219, 227.1, … The terms climb towards 300, the value where 0.9L + 30 = L.
alt: The sequence 210, 219, 227.1, 234.39 and onwards, rising towards 300.
description: The population starts at 200 and each year is 0.9 × the previous value + 30.
The terms increase by less each year and approach 300, where 0.9L + 30 = L.
